name: PORT-16
description: FIELD-16 with a register file that has two read ports and one write port. The register numbers in the instruction word go straight to the file's address inputs, so ADD R0, R1, R2 reads both registers in one tick and writes the sum in the next.
tagline: FIELD-16 with two read ports and a write port

programs.name: Hello, world on the LCD
programs.description: FIELD-16's hello with its own greeting: OUT reads its register through port a

programs.name: Fibonacci on the LCD
programs.description: ADD R0, R1, R2 is two ticks: both ports read, then the write port stores
